card.name: End of poem line or CI upper bound
card.fires_on: The punctuation or space ending a line of rhymed verse, just before the next line starts. Also the digit after the decimal point in the upper limit of a confidence interval.

modes.description: A semicolon, comma or space at the end of a line in old-style rhyming poetry.
